findings.intendedOrder: For each relative process step, remove its ordinary BondPositionVisionActionNode messages, then insert a vision message immediately before each matching PickActionNode.
findings.missingStepBoundary: A relative bond-position config with no enabled matching ProcessStep is collected as null and is later dereferenced through ProcessStepName; the source has no guard.
findings.missingPickBoundary: If a matching PickActionNode is absent, the reinsertion loop adds nothing after removing the original vision messages.
